MF2_array_item_site_drops_the_declared_r._note: The ARRAY emission point (:634 on origin/main). ⛤ HOLE CLOSED by ticket afb25c43: the note below is kept because it records WHY the hole existed, not a standing gap. WAS: «⛔ NO AXIS … create_instance writes a LIST only for exo__Instance_class and aliases, neither of which carries a datatype range … Raised as the one hole this spec leaves open». That was true of the fixtures, not of the code: `applyPropertyDefaultStep` stores ANY resolver result verbatim when it is an array (`Array.isArray(resolved)`), and the live `targetProperty` resolver returns `v.map(String)` for a multi-valued target — so a property whose range is declared and whose value is copied from a multi-valued one reaches this site in production. K18 drives exactly that shape; K19 is its discriminating control (port absent → the same items keep their pre-ticket quoted form). Measured, not predicted (§A44/§A54): MF1 reddens K8/K9 and leaves K18 green, MF2 reddens K18 alone — the two emission points are addressable separately, which is what 'must not disagree' requires to be checkable.
